Method of Attack: SPAM campaign distributing password protected Word document with embedded obfuscated Javascript
Javascript downloads DLL from malicious URLs and executes it via regsvr32.exe
Installs keylogger and data stealing Trojan
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of wscript.exe, regsvr32.exe, %AppData% folder)
Attack Vector: SPAM email with password protected Word document attachment
Execution of embedded obfuscated Javascript file
Indicators of Compromise: Files installed in %AppData% with .ogg extension and random numeric names (e.g., 35116.ogg)
